#7647 (source defect: the program SENDs / RECEIVEs a map with no FROM / INTO, so IBM's translator reads the map's symbolic area, but it never COPYs or declares that area; the BMS source in the clone does not supply it, since the symbolic map reaches a program only through its own COPY, so the program does not compile; both census rows also read `<name>: undeclared item`. IBM: EXEC CICS SEND MAP FROM / RECEIVE MAP INTO default to the map name suffixed O / I (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=summary-send-map, https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=summary-receive-map), and the program copies the symbolic map in (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=output-acquiring-defining-storage-maps). Rule-10 review 2026-11-07)

gaps.gap: MOVE: literal beyond the single-byte code page
gaps.owner: #7526 (source defect: no single-byte EBCDIC code page holds the character, so the source as stored is no input an IBM compiler reads; the translator refuses the statement, register D4. IBM: Enterprise COBOL 6.4: basic alphanumeric literals hold characters in a single-byte EBCDIC character set, and CODEPAGE sets their encoding (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cobol-zos/6.4?topic=options-codepage). Owner ruling 2026-11-06 (#7526); rule-10 review 2026-11-07)
